title: Matrine targets beta-catenin and blocks the formation of beta-catenin/TCF7L2 complex to promote ferroptosis and inhibit metastasis in triple-negative breast cancer.
authors: Sang, Yazhou; Hu, Yue; Liang, Ruohan; Zhang, Yueyue; Du, Hongyuan; Zhang, Huilan; Chen, Juan; Zhang, Yaqiong; Cao, Xuan
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苦参碱靶向β-catenin并阻断其与转录因子TCF7L2复合物形成以促进铁死亡和抑制三阴性乳腺癌转移，虽涉及TF-DNA复合物但核心是药物-蛋白互作，非TF-DNA结合建模，方法仅分子对接且无AI/物理模拟创新。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is still incurable, exhibiting a high propensity for metastasis. Matrine has been confirmed to possess anti-tumor properties. Nevertheless, the precise mechanism by which matrine inhibits TNBC metastasis remains uncertain. PURPOSE: This investigation aimed to explore whether matrine could disrupt TNBC metastasis. METHODS: The migratory capacity of TNBC cells was assessed via wound healing and transwell assays. Then, we evaluated whether matrine directly interacts with beta-catenin (beta-cat). Molecular docking combined with plasmid point mutation was employed to ascertain the specific amino acid binding sites of matrine and beta-cat. Next, we evaluated the impact of matrine on the formation of beta-cat/transcription factor 7 like 2 (TCF7L2) complex and whether matrine could induce ferroptosis (FPT) in TNBC. The mouse lung metastasis model was utilized to assess the potential of matrine in inhibiting TNBC metastasis. RESULTS: Our research proved that matrine could directly target beta-cat and abrogate the interaction of beta-cat and TCF7L2, thus inhibiting the Wnt/beta-cat downstream signaling pathway. Furthermore, matrine weakened the regulatory effect of TCF7L2 on glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4) and enhanced FPT by hindering the formation of the beta-cat/TCF7L2 transcription complex. In addition, matrine-induced FPT effectively suppressed epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) in TNBC. CONCLUSIONS: This study demonstrates that matrine impedes the stimulation of the Wnt/beta-cat pathway, has anti-metastatic effects on TNBC by triggering ferroptosis and inhibiting EMT.
abstract_zh: 背景：三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）仍无法治愈，且具有高转移倾向。苦参碱已被证实具有抗肿瘤特性。然而，苦参碱抑制TNBC转移的确切机制仍不明确。目的：本研究旨在探讨苦参碱是否能干扰TNBC的转移。方法：通过伤口愈合和Transwell实验评估TNBC细胞的迁移能力。随后，我们评估了苦参碱是否直接与β-连环蛋白（beta-cat）相互作用。采用分子对接结合质粒点突变技术，以确定苦参碱与beta-cat的特异性氨基酸结合位点。接下来，我们评估了苦参碱对beta-cat/转录因子7类似物2（TCF7L2）复合物形成的影响，以及苦参碱是否能诱导TNBC中的铁死亡（FPT）。利用小鼠肺转移模型评估苦参碱抑制TNBC转移的潜力。结果：我们的研究证明，苦参碱能直接靶向beta-cat，并消除beta-cat与TCF7L2的相互作用，从而抑制Wnt/beta-cat下游信号通路。此外，苦参碱削弱了TCF7L2对谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）的调控作用，并通过阻碍beta-cat/TCF7L2转录复合物的形成增强FPT。另外，苦参碱诱导的FPT有效抑制了TNBC中的上皮-间质转化（EMT）。结论：本研究证明，苦参碱阻碍Wnt/beta-cat通路的激活，通过触发铁死亡和抑制EMT对TNBC产生抗转移作用。
